en: A vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a broad city street lined with multi‑story stone buildings in a late 19th/early 20th‑century style. A tram runs along tracks in the center of the street, with people walking on sidewalks and horse‑drawn carriages visible near the buildings. Trees line the right side of the avenue. The caption at the bottom identifies the location as Birger Jarlsgatan in Stockholm, and Swedish text signage can be seen on the central corner building.
